_comment: Hand-written meta descriptions, one per route. Keep each under 155 characters: Google truncates beyond that. A route missing here falls back to an automatic clip of the Sanity description, which cuts mid-sentence. Key = route path.
/: Antonio Carcagnì, Digital & IT leader in Milan. Meter-to-Cash, digital products, cloud operations and Agile delivery for a national energy retailer.
/projects: Nineteen programme and project records across Meter-to-Cash, digital channels, technology governance, cloud, and vendor and contract management.
/projects/engie-b2c-mobile-app: Direct product ownership of the highest-frequency digital touchpoint of a national energy retailer, rebuilt for speed, stability and adoption.
/projects/online-customer-area: The web self-service half of a national energy retailer's digital model, run as direct product manager alongside the mobile app.
/projects/meter-to-cash-programme: Managerial ownership of the IT and Digital portfolio from meter reading to cash collection, across a customer base of one million supply points.
/projects/technology-leadership-and-gove: Technology governance held in parallel with every other role: operating model, demand and prioritisation, delivery KPIs and technical debt.
/projects/agile-and-safe-delivery: Scaled agile adoption and end-to-end release process optimisation across the delivery teams of a national energy retailer.
/projects/vodafone-data-centre-operation: Three years inside a global telecom operator's data centre estate: keeping 24 European sites healthy and retiring what no longer earned its space.
/projects/vodafone-technology-innovation: Technology scouting turned into a governed pipeline, from radar entry to a productised service a global telecom group could actually adopt.
/projects/fca-wiadvisor-field-rollout: Digital service reception rolled out across FCA France's national dealer network, one site at a time.
/projects/the-way-of-life-steam-game: Co-founded a four-person studio and shipped a narrative game to a million downloads. Everything outside the code was mine to solve.
/projects/metering-and-master-data: A meter data platform and a master data management layer as the foundation of the billing chain for a national energy retailer.
/projects/billing-and-invoicing: Bill redesign, hourly billing and the replatforming of the customer communication engine inside a Meter-to-Cash portfolio.
/projects/credit-and-collections: Credit platform renewal, payment method shift and automation of the collections cycle across a one million customer base.
/projects/regulatory-compliance: Turning a continuous stream of energy authority resolutions into delivered IT changes, on fixed legal deadlines.
/projects/customer-care-and-feedback: Closing the loop between what customers say and what the organisation changes, and automating the regulated part of it.
/projects/data-platform-and-analytics: Customer intelligence built on a governed lakehouse rather than channel-local reporting, across a national energy retailer's digital estate.
/projects/cloud-operations-and-devops: Cloud migration, DevOps adoption and disciplined application lifecycle management across a national energy retailer's digital estate.
/projects/erp-modernization-as400-to-dyn: Switching off AS/400 at two Italian manufacturers, and translating what the business actually did into requirements an integrator could build.
/projects/aws-cloud-training: Teaching AWS cloud fundamentals to roughly a hundred people as an authorised instructor, in parallel with a full-time corporate role.
/projects/werank: A fantasy league for competitive League of Legends built on Riot's public match data. A four-person side venture that never got to run.
